title: Marvelous Designer 2024: Soft Body Simulation
description:

transcript: This video will cover the new SoftBody Simulation feature added to the Marvelous Designer with version 2024.0. SoftBody Simulation is a feature that adds elasticity to the avatar's body shape. The surface on the skin deforms when wearing tight clothing, just like real human skin can. This feature is available for the default version 2 avatars in Marvelous Designer. It can also be applied to avatars converted with the Auto-Convert to Avatar feature. Of the three options in Auto-Convert to Avatar, the rigging-only and size-editable options are the only applicable to avatars converted with the feature. Now let's apply SoftBody Simulation. Prepare your Marvelous Designer default avatar or converted avatar. Click on the avatar and the avatar properties will appear. The avatar properties will appear in the property window to the right. When you turn on the SoftBody Simulation option, it will be applied to the avatar and the option to adjust the soft body stiffness will appear below. For stiffness, the smaller the value, the softer the surface of the avatar will be when simulated. When SoftBody Simulation is enabled, an icon will be displayed in the 3D window to indicate the SoftBody Simulation is active. When the simulation is active, you can see the surface tighten as a tight bandage wraps around the skin surface. This feature does not apply when clicking and dragging the avatar surface alone. The avatar surface must have an outfit to be affected. When recording an animation, after enabling SoftBody Simulation, the SoftBody animation will be recorded along with the clothing. You will see a SoftBody item added to the avatar. You can see the SoftBody item added to the animation layer. You can see the SoftBody item added to the animation layer. The SoftBody animation can be exported as an Alembic file, while other formats will only export based on the current frame. When exporting to an Alembic file, make sure to check the box for Include Avatar Shape to Export. And this was a quick introduction to using the SoftBody Simulation feature. Thank you for watching.
summary: ```# Marvelous Designer 2024: Soft Body Simulation ## Introduction to Soft Body Simulation This video will cover the new Soft Body Simulation feature added to Marvelous Designer with version 2024.0. Soft Body Simulation is a feature that adds elasticity to the avatar's body shape. The surface on the skin deforms when wearing tight clothing, just like real human skin can. ## Compatibility with Avatars This feature is available for the default version 2 avatars in Marvelous Designer. It can also be applied to avatars converted with the Auto-Convert to Avatar feature. Of the three options in Auto-Convert to Avatar, the rigging-only and size-editable options are the only ones applicable to avatars converted with the feature. ## Applying Soft Body Simulation Now, let's apply Soft Body Simulation. Prepare your Marvelous Designer default avatar or converted avatar. Click on the avatar, and the avatar properties will appear. The avatar properties will appear in the property window to the right. ### Enabling Soft Body Simulation When you turn on the Soft Body Simulation option, it will be applied to the avatar, and the option to adjust the soft body stiffness will appear below. For stiffness, the smaller the value, the softer the surface of the avatar will be when simulated. ### Visual Indicators When Soft Body Simulation is enabled, an icon will be displayed in the 3D window to indicate that the Soft Body Simulation is active. When the simulation is active, you can see the surface tighten as a tight bandage wraps around the skin surface. ## Interaction and Limitations This feature does not apply when clicking and dragging the avatar surface alone. The avatar surface must have an outfit to be affected. ## Recording Animations When recording an animation, after enabling Soft Body Simulation, the Soft Body animation will be recorded along with the clothing. You will see a Soft Body item added to the avatar, and this item will be visible in the animation layer. ## Exporting Soft Body Animation The Soft Body animation can be exported as an Alembic file, while other formats will only export based on the current frame. When exporting to an Alembic file, make sure to check the box for "Include Avatar Shape to Export." ## Conclusion And this was a quick introduction to using the Soft Body Simulation feature. Thank you for watching. ```
